id: Chamber Music New Zealand — The John Psathas Group-Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Chamber Music New Zealand — The John Psathas Group
venue: Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
New Zealand/Greek composer John Psathas has reached a level of global success unparalleled by any other Kiwi composer. He regularly collaborates with musicians at the top of their game. Chamber Music New Zealand is proud to help John usher in a new supergroup of international artists devoted to bringing his music to life. The John Psathas Group performs for the first time at the Michael Fowler Centre on 9 August. It presents a programme that shapes a vision for the future of chamber music, one that is compelling, thought-provoking, and incorporates contemporary ideas, issues, and technologies. 
Says John of the concert — “Each of the works tells some part of the story of our shared humanity. Relentless projects text about the experience of women through the ages, and The Nature of Reality pools together the words of writers currently at the forefront of describing how the social fabric of today’s world is being reinvented around us.”

name: High Tide Festival 2026
long_description:
High Tide is back and bigger than ever. Waitangi Park on the Wellington waterfront will again host the multi-genre music festival. With drum & bass, house, grime, and hip-hop on the music menu there should be something for anyone looking for a party atmosphere.
Since 2022 Hide Tide has brought a wide range of international, New Zealand, and local music talent to Wellington. 
There are some big names announced for the 2026 installment including New Zealand exclusive shows from MK and Ocean Wisdom. Other world-class acts include Hybrid Minds, MK, Wax Motif, P- Money x Whiney, Fred V, and Charlotte Haining. Some major names in the Kiwi scene are also performing like Cee, Ponz Seini, Bari & Lambchompz, and Rob the Bank. Check out the complete list on the High Tide webpage.
High Tide is all about creating a safe space to celebrate music, culture and connection. The event promotes inclusion and diversity, offering a safe and accessible festival experience.
It's a great way to celebrate an early summer in style. The R18 event kicks off at 12.30pm and the beats don’t stop until 10.30pm. If you’re looking to dance and party under the sun and stars then High Tide 2026 is for you.
Presale
General sale for High Tide is Wednesday 12 August at 7:00pm. There is an exclusive pre-sale an hour earlier for those who sign up now. Get in and beat the crowd.
